headline: Blazamut mining giant
title: Blazamut | Mining Seven Fire Giant | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want the best miner in Palworld one point zero? Blazamut is a Fire Pal that works Mining level seven and Kindling level six. You can find it on Flamepulse Islet, and its alpha is a level fifty two boss. Bring a Water team and strong spheres to catch it. Will you take Blazamut down to your mine? Comment below!
description: Blazamut in Palworld 1.0 is a Fire Pal with Mining level seven and Kindling level six, found on Flamepulse Islet.
joke: Blazamut says it digs hot deals.
